title: SIIL SASS JA REBANE RIIN KELGUTAVAD

characters.name: SIIL SASS
characters.description: Väike pehme pruun siil ümarate okastega, kandmas rohelist silmkoelist mütsi ja punast salli. Suured uudishimulikud silmad ja sõbralik naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: REBANE RIIN
characters.description: Väike erk-oranž rebane koheva sabaga, kandmas kollast kampsunit ja siniseid kindaid. Rõõmsameelne ja mänguhimuline näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Lumine mägi parkides
locations.description: Snowy hill outdoors in a park during winter daylight. Pure white snow covering the gentle slope, three green pine trees dusted with snow on top of the hill, crisp blue winter sky with a light warm sun. Simple clean environment, warm bright lighting, cute children's book cartoon style.

pages.text: SIIL SASS JA REBANE RIIN ON MÄEL.
pages.scene: Siil Sass (cute hedgehog in green hat and red scarf) and Rebane Riin (cute orange fox in yellow sweater and blue mittens) are standing together at the top of a snowy hill outdoors under a blue winter sky. Both characters look excited and happy. Snow-covered pine trees are visible in the background. Cartoon style.

Siil Sass and Rebane Riin stand at the top of the snowy hill beside a shiny red wooden sled resting on the white snow. Sass is smiling and pointing at the red sled. Riin clasps her gloved hands in delight. Cartoon style.

Siil Sass and Rebane Riin sit together on the red wooden sled at the top of the snowy hill. Sass sits at the front holding the front of the sled, while Riin sits behind him holding his waist. Both look ready to slide down. Cartoon style.

The red sled with Siil Sass in front and Rebane Riin behind is gliding dynamically down the gentle snowy hill. Soft trails of white snow spray behind the sled. Both characters have joyful open-mouthed expressions as their scarves blow gently in the breeze. Cartoon style.

Close-up action view of Siil Sass sitting at the front of the red sled sliding down the snow hill. Sass holds tightly to the wooden sled handle with his gloved paws, looking brave and happy. Riin holds onto Sass from behind. Cartoon style.

Rebane Riin sits behind Siil Sass on the fast-moving red sled sliding down the snowy hill, raising one blue-gloved paw in the air and laughing loudly with joy. Sass steers happily at the front. Cartoon style.

The red sled comes to a smooth, safe stop in a soft, fluffy snowdrift at the bottom of the hill. Siil Sass and Rebane Riin are still sitting on the sled, surrounded by gentle puffs of white powdery snow, smiling with wide happy eyes. Cartoon style.

Siil Sass and Rebane Riin are standing next to their red sled at the foot of the hill, doing a happy high-five with their gloved paws. Both characters are beaming with joy. The snowy hill and pine trees are in the background under bright sunshine. Cartoon style.
